landing.tagline: Interactive patient cases for clinical education
landing.aboutSubtitle: Free and open-source interactive patient case platform for clinical education
landing.aboutTeacherHeading: Built for the demands of clinical education
landing.aboutTeacherD1: Not just disjointed quiz questions, but a cohesive clinical journey (history, physical exam, lab results, and decision points). X-rays, CT scans, ECGs, and histology slides open in a full-resolution zoomable lightbox with a single click.
landing.aboutTeacherD2: Locked 16:9 aspect ratio and high-contrast typography guarantee readability all the way to the back row of 200-seat lecture halls. Full support for wireless presentation clickers and keyboard shortcuts. Present multiple cases sequentially using the same room code.
landing.aboutTeacherD3: No user accounts to manage, no cloud contracts, and no GDPR registries. All patient cases and high-res images are stored locally as .medcase files on your device. Create new cases easily using the built-in WYSIWYG editor.
landing.aboutStudentD1: Answers are never linked to student names, emails, or device identifiers. This lowers the inhibition threshold, encouraging active participation even in complex clinical dilemmas without fear of embarrassment.
landing.aboutStudentD2: Students join in seconds using their smartphones by entering the 4-digit code or scanning the on-screen QR code. Works in any modern browser without app store downloads.
landing.aboutStudentD3: Responses aggregate and visualize on the main projector in real time. Teacher-guided debriefing and group discussion deepen clinical reasoning on the spot.
landing.aboutAuthorD1: MedCases was designed and developed by Pauno Komulainen, a specialist in Obstetrics and Gynecology based in Kuopio, Finland. The platform grew out of a personal drive to revitalize clinical lectures with a tool tailored to multistep medical scenarios and rich diagnostic imaging.
landing.aboutAuthorT2: Free for everyone in healthcare education
landing.aboutAuthorD2: MedCases is completely free to use across medical, dental, and healthcare education in universities, colleges, and hospital clinics worldwide. No subscriptions, no ads, no hidden costs.
landing.aboutAuthorD3: All source code is fully open. Anyone is free to audit, contribute, or self-host their own MedCases server within their institution's private infrastructure.
